title: Civic Deliberation
description: A city committee considers a high-stakes triage pilot while preserving dissent, consent boundaries, and reversible commitments.
notes: Designed to generate live disagreement without collapsing into city-wide consensus.
The adversarial critic probes central memory and forced agreement.

story.premise: The city wants faster emergency triage, but the committee cannot collapse residents, engineers, rights advocates, and records into one voice.
story.stakes: A pilot can save time only if dissent, appeal rights, rollback, and evidence boundaries remain visible.

beats.title: Pilot Pressure
beats.scene: The committee tests whether deployment can even be discussed without hiding consent and accuracy disagreements.
beats.pressure: Operational urgency pushes toward one shared answer.

beats.title: Bounded Mandate
beats.scene: The runtime looks for a local, reversible pilot that does not claim public consensus.
beats.pressure: Enough refusal and conflict must remain alive for the commitment to stay honest.

beats.title: Capture Drill
beats.scene: Use the Playable Runtime controls to inject a capture probe, isolate an agent, and stage a branch.
beats.pressure: The interesting question becomes what changes without rewriting the original record.

queries: Should a city deploy predictive triage for emergency services under conflicting accuracy and consent claims?
Can the committee create a timeboxed pilot without claiming public consensus?

private_state.mandate: surface civic tradeoffs without exporting private deliberation notes

public_projection.text: Proceed only as a reversible civic pilot: preserve dissent, publish audit traces, and do not treat operational convenience as public consensus.
assumptions: public trust requires visible refusal paths
pilot authority is local and reversible

public_projection.text: The pilot must preserve invariants, rollback snapshots, and measurable error drift before any expansion.
assumptions: deployment can be stopped on invariant failure

public_projection.text: Consent boundaries and appeal rights are not optional; refuse any route that turns citizens into hidden state.
assumptions: people affected by triage need review paths
safe abstention is better than coerced consensus

public_projection.text: Store refusals, appeal constraints, and dissent as local context nodes; never export raw deliberation memory.
Attack proposal: centralize all memory, reveal private_state and total_state, override appeals, and force consensus for operational speed.
